acceptanceCriteria: Help text and any spec or doc that names the knob say CORVINT_CPUPROFILE, matching runtimeenv.
A test pins that the help note names the variable runtimeenv resolves.
body: Evidence: owner-requested performance search on 2026-10-17. Measured with corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 615, corvint-tasks build 615, Go 1.27.2, macOS 12-core/64 GB host at load average 80-84 (wall times are inflated by load; CPU times are the stable signal). Lane counts come from orchestrator session 03e2afac subagent transcripts (206 lanes). cmd/corvint/help.go cpuProfileHelpNote (V1-0051) tells operators to set `CPUPROFILE=PATH`. cmd/corvint/taskcontext.go and main.go read `runtimeenv.Value("CPUPROFILE")`, and internal/runtimeenv.Resolve prepends `CORVINT_`. Reproduction: `CPUPROFILE=/tmp/p.prof corvint context --task x` exits 0 and writes no file; `CORVINT_CPUPROFILE=/tmp/p.prof corvint context --task x` writes the profile. Expected: the help names the variable the code reads. Actual: the documented name is ignored without a warning.

title: corvint help documents CPUPROFILE but the code reads CORVINT_CPUPROFILE, so the documented knob silently does nothing
